description.value: Wings on Kingsway is the Burnaby franchise of the WINGS restaurant chain, located on the busy Kingsway corridor connecting Vancouver and Burnaby. The restaurant is known for award-winning chicken wings in 28 globally-inspired flavours, alongside a full menu of burgers, salads, pastas, and plant-based options. It offers indoor seating and online ordering, making it a convenient sit-down meal stop for cyclists travelling the Kingsway route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's /locations/ subpage confirms the Burnaby location at 6879 Kingsway, BC V5E 1E4 with phone (604) 525-7414, directly matching the OSM phone tag. The /menu/ subpage confirms online ordering, vegetarian (Cauli' Wingerz) and gluten-smart options. The homepage contains injected casino/gambling spam text unrelated to the restaurant, indicating a likely website compromise, but the remaining subpages yield reliable business data.
concerns: Website homepage contains injected spam/SEO content promoting online casino gambling services (South African minimum deposit casinos, gamblizard.ca) — the site appears to have been compromised or is running malicious SEO injections. Subpage content remains reliable.
OSM address field is empty; address sourced from website /locations/ subpage.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A confirmed, operating chain restaurant on a major cycling corridor (Kingsway) with indoor seating, takeout, and vegetarian options — a practical food stop for touring cyclists. Bike parking status is unconfirmed but warrants a site check.
